render_dragon_scene_actor_exclusion.evidence: Exact-build PE: every callable table of the 51 extractAndDrawWithExclusion lambda instantiations was located from the lambda type descriptors (descriptor = name-16; _Target_type getter = lea rax,[rip+rel];ret). Table slot 2 is the shared _Do_call 0x5689080 for all SceneObjectActors passes; slot 3 is the per-instantiation type getter, whose lea target equals the descriptor listed above and in the type-name blob at 0x126CD535 / 0x126D0D15 / 0x12781465 / 0x12784D95. The body decompiles to a tag-set test whose default answer is true (permit), so a detour that preserves the original answer for every other object can exclude a chosen object without touching game state. Evidence: ~/Documents/PEXData/diet/evidence-07-render-wire.md §1-2.
